answer: The jetty index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1733 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the garden. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the dawn queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. That is 34 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
